content:
*walks over to observe your pose*

Great effort getting into Warrior One! I can see you're really working hard. Let me help you refine a few things to get the most out of this powerful pose.

**First, let's talk about your spine.** I notice it's curving a bit right now. Think about lengthening from your tailbone all the way through the crown of your head. Imagine a string gently pulling you upward. Draw your belly button slightly in toward your spine to support your lower back. This will help you find that beautiful, straight alignment.

**Now, let's look at those arms.** Your arms aren't quite reaching straight up toward the ceiling yet. Try to extend them fully, reaching through your fingertips as if you're trying to touch the sky. Keep your shoulders relaxed and away from your ears – we want strength without tension. Palms can face each other or come together if that feels comfortable.

**Finally, check your front knee.** Right now it's drifting a bit, and we want that knee stacked directly over your ankle. This protects your joint and builds stability. You may need to adjust your stance – either shortening or lengthening it – to find that proper alignment.

*steps back to observe*

Make those adjustments... Yes! That's looking much stronger already. How does that feel? Remember, yoga is a practice – every time you come to the mat, you're improving. Keep breathing and hold steady. Wonderful work!
